verdict.rationale: Factory is an AI coding platform, so a training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions data-usage policies, training opt-outs, or zero-retention commitments. Worktree isolation and BYOM machines concern execution environments, not whether data is used to train models, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
